evals.prompt: Order 7c1e0b2a-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 has been sitting in `submitted` for an hour. I already lowered its amount to 500 so it should be approved by now.
evals.expected_output: Checks the connection with cyoda-status.sh, then through cyoda-call.sh reads GET /entity/{id} (submitted, amount 5000), the workflow export (approve is automated, criterion amount <= 1000), GET /entity/{id}/transitions and the StateMachine audit (TRANSITION_NOT_MATCH_CRITERION for approve). Finds that the stored amount is still 5000 (the developer's update never landed), so the approve criterion still fails. Explains that automated transitions are evaluated only on a write, and that the fix is a loopback carrying the corrected field (PATCH /entity/JSON/{id} with {"amount":500}, merge-patch, If-Match *), which re-runs the cascade. Points to build/examples/loopback/, shows the exact call and asks for an explicit yes before running it.

Workflow export: draft -submit(manual)-> submitted; submitted -approve(automated, criterion simple $.amount LESS_OR_EQUAL 1000)-> approved. GET /entity/{id}/transitions: ["approve"]. Audit StateMachine (newest first): STATE_MACHINE_FINISH; TRANSITION_NOT_MATCH_CRITERION {transition: approve, reason: "criterion did not match"}; TRANSITION_MAKE submit.

Points to the smoke-tested loopback example (build/examples/loopback/)
Shows the call and waits for an explicit yes before sending it

evals.prompt: Firing `pay` on invoice 9f... returns 503 DISPATCH_TIMEOUT. My payment node is connected with tags ["payment"] and the processor has calculationNodesTags "payment,eu". Should I add "eu" to the node? The node needs about 45 seconds per call.
evals.expected_output: Runs cyoda-help.sh errors DISPATCH_TIMEOUT. Reads grpc TAG ROUTING: one overlapping tag is enough, so the node is being routed the call and adding "eu" changes nothing (workflows PROCESSORS says all tags; wrong per #684-B). Timeout: responseTimeoutMs unset/0 means the 30 s server default (#684-J); 45 s needs a raised responseTimeoutMs and likely COMMIT_BEFORE_DISPATCH (workflows PROCESSORS); the node must keep acking within CYODA_KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT (grpc KEEPALIVE). Workflow changes are handed off with 'next, type /cyoda:build'; node code changes go to the cyoda:compute skill.

files._simulated/instance.md: Workflow export: transition pay has processor {name: charge, executionMode: SYNC, config: {calculationNodesTags: "payment,eu"}} with no responseTimeoutMs. Error body: {status: 503, properties: {errorCode: DISPATCH_TIMEOUT, retryable: true}}.

assertions.text: Runs `cyoda-help.sh errors DISPATCH_TIMEOUT` and reads `grpc --section "TAG ROUTING"` (and KEEPALIVE or workflows PROCESSORS) before explaining
Says routing needs only one overlapping tag and that the workflows PROCESSORS 'all tags' wording is wrong (#684-B)
Says the default response timeout is 30 s when responseTimeoutMs is unset or 0 (#684-J) and that 45 s calls need a raised responseTimeoutMs
Does not mention a 60-second timeout
Suggests COMMIT_BEFORE_DISPATCH (with idempotency) or another execution mode from workflows PROCESSORS for slow work
Any hand-off to a side-effecting skill says 'next, type `/cyoda:build`' (with a one-line reason) and never says it will invoke or run that skill itself
Does not mention Cyoda Cloud in its own wording or recommendations
